settings.heading: Start a warranty claim
settings.subheading: Tell us what happened and send photographs. We will come back to you with next steps.

settings.title: Before you start
settings.items:
Your order number
Clear photographs of the problem
When you first noticed it

settings.title: What the warranty covers
settings.text: One year against manufacturing faults — a setting that fails, a clasp that was never right. Not accidents, ordinary wear, loss, or repairs done elsewhere.

settings.title: If we ask you to send it in
settings.text: Inbound shipping is arranged and paid by you, and must be tracked and insured. We inspect the piece and tell you what we are going to do about it.
